$comment: MUGEN characters from the web, none cleared for commercial use (fan-made, often from commercial games): roster.json marks them commercialUse false, so GI_COMMERCIAL_ONLY=true keeps them off stream. Only this recipe is committed; put each downloaded file in mugen/ (repo root, not in git) and run `pnpm mugen:import`, which checks the checksum and installs it into IKEMEN_DIR/chars/<id>/. `name` is what the stream and the game's health bar show.

characters.name: Silly Barney
characters.author: XboxRob11
characters.notes: A joke Barney the Dinosaur (2007, remade 2017); the file's own displayname is an insult, so it gets ours. Downloaded by the owner; the exact page is still to note.

characters.author: Basher22
